Maya (CEO): Quick heads-up: all-hands Thurs 9:00am PT — 40m. Focused agenda: exec pulse, short launch demo, policy note, and Q&A. Please drop any questions here or add to the form. :calendar:
Maya (CEO): Agenda:
- 7m: company pulse + hiring note
- 12m: launch demo (live) + rollback play
- 6m: policy update: retention/audit exports
- 10m: roadmap highlights + Q&A
- 5m: close + owners
Maya (CEO): Slides & preread: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/redwood-allhands-4234 (view/comment)
Jamal (VP Product): Demo will show Hosted -> Dedicated fallback and the canary gate. I'll post sample prompts to the deck.
Leila (Engineering Manager): Can we add a 1-slide post-deploy smoke checklist? I'll dump it in the deck.
Kendall (Head Eng): Infra will warm up capacity 10m before demo. SRE on standby for 1h after rollout.
Ivy (People Ops): In-person seats + lunch signup: tinyurl.com/rw-thu-allhands  RSVP by Wed 5pm.
Comms-bot: Submit prioritized Qs here: https://forms.gle/rw-thu-allhands-qa (1-2 bullets) — we'll prioritize pre-submitted.
Ops-bot: Calendar invite created and company reminders scheduled. Recording & captions enabled.
Maya (CEO): Note on policy: default dev org retention drops to 90 days; enterprise customers via contract. Legal approved; official doc will be posted after the meeting.
Jamal (VP Product): Runbook draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/redwood-rollout-wip — feedback welcome.
Maya (CEO): If you want your question anonymized in the digest, reply here with "anon". We'll close this thread in 72h with final actions. :sparkles:
